name: Sleeper Stretch
steps: Lie on your side with your bottom arm extended straight forward at shoulder height and elbow bent to 90 degrees so your forearm points up.
Roll your torso slightly backward off the shoulder blade to keep your shoulder comfortably aligned.
Use your top hand to press your bottom wrist gently downward toward the floor until you feel a mild stretch in the back of your shoulder.
Hold calmly with steady breathing for the target duration, release slowly, and switch sides.
tips: Apply gentle, gradual pressure and stop immediately if you feel any pinching at the front of the shoulder.
Rest your head on a folded towel or pillow so your neck stays completely relaxed.
